entities.name: Illegal Slave Trade and Sugar Wealth
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Despite international abolition of the slave trade, Cuba continued to import enslaved Africans illegally for decades. The last known slave ship arrived in Cuba in 1867. Sugar barons ('sacarocracia') amassed enormous fortunes, making Cuba Spain's most valuable remaining colony.
